entries.title: Where the Water Begins
entries.memory: The day opened slowly — salt on the skin, light on the water, and nowhere else we needed to be.
entries.caption: The day opened slowly — salt on the skin, light on the water, and nowhere else we needed to be.

entries.title: Salt in the Air
entries.memory: Wind, warm light, and the first real breath of the season. We walked until the noise turned into weather.
entries.caption: Wind, warm light, and the first real breath of the season. We walked until the noise turned into weather.

entries.title: A Quiet Shore
entries.memory: Low tide and long pauses — the kind of quiet that only feels full when someone is sitting beside you.
entries.caption: Low tide and long pauses — the kind of quiet that only feels full when someone is sitting beside you.

entries.title: The Little Traveller
entries.memory: We found it near the water’s edge: small, armoured, entirely unbothered by the size of the ocean.
entries.caption: We found it near the water’s edge: small, armoured, entirely unbothered by the size of the ocean.

entries.title: Between Tide & Sand
entries.memory: Footprints filled as fast as we made them. We stopped trying to keep them, and kept walking anyway.
entries.caption: Footprints filled as fast as we made them. We stopped trying to keep them, and kept walking anyway.

entries.title: Until the Next Wave
entries.memory: We left the shore the way you close a good book — slowly, already missing the last page.
entries.caption: We left the shore the way you close a good book — slowly, already missing the last page.
